info.name: Nome — Unified Laravel API (login only)
info.description: Single Laravel application with per-user ownership and no roles. Fill base_url, email and password; select the audio file before upload. AI transport must be configured. For Collection Runner use a 5000 ms delay. simulate_ai=true enables a SIGNED local callback for test data only; do not run a real worker concurrently in this mode. Cleanup is skipped unless allow_cleanup=true. Never export or commit real credentials.

item.name: Core workflow — test accounts only
item.description: Login, create, upload, optional signed simulation, bounded polling, preview, update, export, optional deletion, then logout. A manual upload file must be selected first.

request.description:
Unggah rekaman (form-data, field `audio`). Format: mp3, wav, m4a, ogg. Maksimal 100 MB.

Setelah berhasil, status memo menjadi `processing`. Proses AI berjalan di latar belakang, gunakan endpoint **Status** untuk polling.

Memo yang sedang `pending`/`processing` menolak upload baru (409). Memo `completed` atau `failed` boleh diunggah ulang.

**Catatan Postman:** pilih file pada kolom `audio` di tab Body.
The unified backend returns 503 without changing memo status if NOME_AI_URL or NOME_WEBHOOK_SECRET is missing. Audio is private. Empty or oversized files are rejected.
